title: Instant NuRec: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Reconstruction for Driving Scene Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2607.14203v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: 3D simulation platforms are critical for autonomous driving because they enable end-to-end policy evaluation, thereby reducing development costs and improving safety. In recent years, neural simulation has become predominant, with methods such as NuRec playing a central role; however, these methods remain relatively slow and typically require per-scene tuning. In this work, we present Instant NuRec, a feed-forward neural reconstruction model that turns a short multi-view driving log into a fully simulatable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) world in a single forward pass. The model accepts multi-view input from a calibrated camera rig and emits a layered output consisting of static and dynamic 3DGS layers, a sky cubemap, and per-camera ISP corrections, while providing native support for non-pinhole camera models via 3DGUT. It reconstructs a 10-20-second multi-camera scene in roughly 1.5 seconds and achieves a PSNR on the Waymo Open

translated_title: Instant NuRec：面向驾驶场景仿真的前馈式3D高斯重建
translated_abstract: 3D仿真平台对自动驾驶至关重要，因为它们能够实现端到端的策略评估，从而降低开发成本并提高安全性。近年来，神经仿真已成为主流，以NuRec为代表的方法在其中发挥着核心作用；然而，这些方法仍然相对缓慢，且通常需要针对每个场景进行调优。在本工作中，我们提出了Instant NuRec，这是一种前馈式神经重建模型，能够在单次前向传播中将短时多视角驾驶日志数据转化为完全可仿真的3D高斯溅射（3DGS）世界。该模型接受来自标定相机组的输入，输出由静态和动态3DGS层、天空立方体贴图以及逐相机ISP校正组成的分层结果，同时通过3DGUT原生支持非针孔相机模型。它能在约1.5秒内重建10-20秒的多相机场景，并在Waymo Open数据集上取得了……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: Instant NuRec是一种前馈式神经重建模型，可在单次前向传播中以约1.5秒的速度将短时多视角驾驶日志直接转化为完全可仿真的3D高斯溅射世界，无需逐场景调优，大幅提升了驾驶场景重建与仿真的效率。
en_tdlr: Instant NuRec is a feed-forward neural reconstruction model that turns a short multi-view driving log into a fully simulatable 3D Gaussian Splatting world in a single forward pass, reconstructing 10-20-second multi-camera scenes in roughly 1.5 seconds without per-scene tuning.
